observations.behavior: Replaces a network-backed model catalogue with a generated, static catalogue and removes the loader. The catalogue is no longer fetched; it is baked into the frontend.
observations.posthog_connection: The model dropdown no longer waits for an API call; it uses a generated catalogue. This removes the dependency on the backend tasks API and removes the stale-while-revalidate caching. The catalogue is now supplied by the generated modelCatalog, not fetched. This could reduce latency and remove a failure mode, but the backend still supplies the catalogue, so the frontend is not self

observations.behavior: Adds feature-flag gating to the catalogue. The catalogue is filtered by the user's feature flags; gated models are hidden unless the user has the flag.
observations.posthog_connection: The catalogue is now filtered by feature flags. This could allow PostHog to gate access to certain models without changing the backend. This could also allow PostHog to change the catalogue without changing the backend, but the backend still supplies the catalogue, so the frontend is not self

observations.behavior: Adds a new model label and effort lookup for provider-qualified model IDs. The backend and desktop app both fold them onto the bare id; without this the web alone reads a stored `anthropic/...` run as an unknown model.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new model label and effort lookup for provider-qualified model IDs.
